title: Tribal Labor Sovereignty Act of 2025
committees: H-Education and Workforce Committee: Referred To 2025-02-27 -> Markup By 2025-09-17 -> Reported By 2026-01-16
committee_votes: Education and Workforce Committee 2025-09-17: Ordered reported - 19-16
latest_action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 393.
summary: Tribal Labor Sovereignty Act of 2025 This bill excludes Indian tribes and tribal enterprises and institutions on tribal land from requirements for employers under the National Labor Relations Act (NLRA). (Currently under the NLRA, employers may not engage in unfair labor practices and must allow employees to form unions, engage in collective bargaining, and take collective action.)

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
